title: US Secretary of State Marco Rubio to host G20 Foreign Ministers in Atlanta
excerpt: The meeting is scheduled for October 30–31 to address geopolitical crises and economic challenges.
bodyHtml:
The US State Department announced on October 26, 2026, that Secretary of State Marco Rubio will travel to Atlanta, Georgia, from October 30–31. During this period, Rubio will host the G20 Foreign Ministers’ Meeting.

Secretary Rubio will convene foreign ministers from the world’s leading economies to advance practical cooperation on shared economic and security challenges. The United States intends to work with G20 partners to address geopolitical crises that contribute to global economic shocks.

These discussions will focus on threats to freedom of navigation, energy and food security, and supply chains. According to the US State Department, these talks will set the stage for President Trump’s G20 Leaders’ Summit and the broader economic agenda that leaders will tackle.
